# Munroe’s Tire Service LLC

> Hartford tire shop offering quality used tires, new tires, mounting, balancing and tire repairs.

Visit 3430 Main Street, Hartford, CT 06120. Call (860) 246-0886 for tire availability or if you’re running late. Hours are Monday–Saturday 8 AM–5:30 PM and Sunday 10 AM–3 PM, Hartford local time.

- [Tire selection, replacement steps and service prices](https://munroestireservices.com/#services)
- [Slow tire leak repair](https://munroestireservices.com/slow-tire-leak-repair.html)
- [Wheel lock removal](https://munroestireservices.com/#wheel-lock-removal)
- [Shop hours and directions](https://munroestireservices.com/#visit)
